messages:
Maya: Eva from GreenEdge reached out asking us to pin a specific model variant in EU and APAC regions and enable a lightweight int8 profile. They want predictable latency for a pilot next quarter. Can we scope feasibility and rollout checks?
Zoe: +1. Sales says pilot will start with 3 routes, low qps but strict P95 SLA (<250ms). They're asking for region pinning + quantization profile so cost stays low.
Eva-Cust: Confirming — we need EU region for data residency and APAC later. Pilot traffic ~5-10 qps, latency important. We can be flexible on throughput for the pilot.
Linh: Quick notes: open-llama-3b-v2 works with our runtime but int8 path isn't fully validated on all GPUs we use in APAC. Need to validate quality/regression for int8 vs fp16. Also KV-cache behavior at low qps needs a smoke.
Trevor: Infra constraints: EU capacity looks OK for a small Dedicated pool. APAC has bursty availability; we'd probably need fallback routing to a hosted cheaper instance in APAC for pilot. That means a clear rollback/fallback policy in case quantized variant fails.
Maya: Good. Let's break into checklist: 1) model artifact + weights pin request 2) int8 profile validation (quality + perf) 3) infra capacity reservation in EU, plan for APAC fallback 4) launch criteria & rollback. Who takes which?
Zoe: Sales will own customer comms and get formal SOW language for reserved pilot capacity. I'll collect acceptance criteria from GreenEdge (Eva).
Eva-Cust: I'll provide the test prompt set and 5 representative queries. Also need a small SLA doc for the pilot (not legal).
Linh: I'll run int8 inference tests against our EU dedicated GPU profile and compare outputs vs fp16 using the provided prompts. I'll log per-token latency and a delta quality metric (ROUGE + manual spot-check). ETA 3 business days.
Trevor: I'll check capacity and reserve a 2-GPU Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for the pilot window. For APAC, I'll propose a fallback config that hits hosted instances in ap-northeast-1 and flags when fallback occurs. Need product signoff for fallback behavior.
Maya: For rollout criteria: pass int8 quality threshold (<=1.5% ROUGE delta on the prompt set), P95 latency <250ms, no data-residency violations for EU requests, and documented fallback plan. If any fails, we default to fp16 in EU and hosted fallback in APAC.
Linh: Question: do we allow automatic fallback from int8->fp16 per-request, or do we require a rollout switch? Automatic could hide regressions. Prefer a controlled rollout where we flip in Canary first.
Trevor: Agree with Linh. Canary in EU: route 5% traffic to int8 variant, monitor quality+errors for 48h, then 25% for 24h, then 100% if no regressions. For APAC, start with routed hosted variant then consider Dedicated after capacity confirmed.
Zoe: I'll add these as acceptance bullets in SOW. Also flag pricing delta for int8 vs fp16 for them.
Maya: Ops: create a backlog ticket to pin the model in our catalog with metadata: model_name=open-llama-3b-v2, customer_pin=GreenEdge, regions=[eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1 (fallback)], profile=int8-candidate. Include links to test artifacts.
SupportBot: New ticket created: RID-2026-349. Assigned: Linh (int8 validation), Trevor (capacity), Maya (product), Zoe (customer comms).
Eva-Cust: Thanks — timeline works for us. We'll aim to start pilot in 3 weeks.
Maya: Next steps: Linh run validation (3d), Trevor reserve EU pool (2d), Zoe finalize SOW (2d). We'll reconvene in 5 days in this thread. Ping @everyone if blockers. :thumbsup:
